scope: Actual focused Navigation Bar results and prior stock schema inputs. No new browser execution.

rejected_controls.focused_input_as_stock: wrong passing suite sequence for macos: [('material', '4', '458')]
rejected_controls.missing_step: missing, extra or out-of-order Material step
rejected_controls.invalid_summary: the passing suite totals do not match the runner summary
rejected_controls.other_run_metadata: the browser or adapter differs from the expected runtime metadata
rejected_controls.visible_window: focused window observer reports a failure, a window or a leftover process
rejected_controls.overlapping_label: the pill or label lost its specified geometry or clipped its own cell
rejected_controls.activation_count: wrong keyboard or pointer activation, or a title escaped the fixed header
rejected_controls.identical_scroll_pngs: wheel screenshots did not show changing content
rejected_controls.wrong_theme_png: decoded bar, pill or rounded corner pixels disagree with the report
